mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (all else equal) reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.8, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO decline > 0.5% over 3 months), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm payroll employment (all else equal) indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 4.5%) indicates restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS >= 4.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In housing bust regimes (HOUST below 1200 thousand units), depressed housing activity reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
